$comment: School crests (one per academy school) and stand-in crests by mana colour for campaign chapters and gauntlet runs. Replaces the drawn Crest in ModeArt.tsx.
style: Heraldic school crests: one heater-shaped shield per cell, front view, perfectly symmetrical, all the same shield outline and size, gilded antique gold rim, enamel field in the given colour, one embossed gold emblem in the centre. Each shield fills about 85% of its cell's height.
